author: David Bombal
description:
High latency, jitter, or slow speeds don’t always mean there’s something wrong with your WiFi. The issue could be your actual internet connection.

In this example, we test an Airbnb network and see how a simple score can help identify where the problem really is, so you know what needs fixing instead of wasting time troubleshooting the wrong thing.

title: Your WiFi Might NOT Be the Problem
